{"action":"sql","sql":"SELECT cm.seg_cd, SUM(oh.tot_amt) AS tot_revenue
FROM ord_hdr oh
JOIN cust_mstr cm
  ON cm.cust_id = oh.cust_id
  AND oh.ord_dt >= cm.eff_start_dt
  AND (cm.eff_end_dt IS NULL OR oh.ord_dt < cm.eff_end_dt)
WHERE oh.sts_cd <> 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY cm.seg_cd","reason":"Aggregated non-cancelled order revenue by as-of customer segment via SCD2 join."}
